listing.name: XXVII Battle group v0.9.7
listing.summary: Add a mid-tech battle group. Having some vanilla-like ships. Having some special faction weapons, but all of these are build-in their ships.
listing.aiSummary: Adds the Shackles Garrison faction, featuring mid-tech ships with built-in specialized weapons and unique lore-driven missions.

description: Introduces the Shackles Garrison, a faction formed from the remnants of the XXVII Battlegroup seeking revenge. The mod adds mid-tech ships that resemble vanilla designs but feature specialized faction weapons integrated directly into their hulls. It includes specific mission chains that provide rewards, encouraging players to complete them before starting new runs.
